name: Sugamo Jizo-dori

en.name: Sugamo Jizo-dori
en.description: Affectionately known as 'Harajuku for Grandmas', this lively 800-meter shopping street is famous for Togenuki Jizo temple and red lucky underwear shops. It features traditional senbei rice crackers and warm local hospitality.
en.notes: Explore local specialty food stalls and boutique shops at a relaxed pace.
en.reservation: No advance reservation required; tickets available on arrival.
en.parking: Commercial district paid parking garages available nearby.

ja.name: 巣鴨地蔵通り商店街
ja.description: 「おばあちゃんの原宿」の愛称で親しまれるとげぬき地蔵尊の門前商店街です。名物の赤パンツや手焼き煎餅店が立ち並び、賑やかで温かな下町情緒を満喫できます。
highlights: 巣鴨地蔵通り商店街の名所
ja.reservation: 事前予約不要。現地にてチケットをご購入いただくか、自由にご見学いただけます。
ja.parking: 周辺の有料駐車場または公共駐車場をご利用いただけます。
